sources.title: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset
sources.verification: Opened full official record including variables table and generation rules
key_claims: Synthetic dataset with 10000 rows, six input features, IDs and failure targets.
Temperature units are K, speed rpm, torque Nm and tool wear minutes.
Failure-mode columns are targets and can leak Machine failure if used as predictors.
sources.download_status: Official approximately 510 KB CSV download listed; binary not downloaded in this research
sources.limits: Does not establish performance on real semiconductor assets or directly supply remaining useful life trajectories. Leakage diagnosis is a preparation recommendation based on the target schema.
